exact_two_polarization_convention.columns: Let X=[b1,b2], J=[j1,j2], D=[d1,d2] in the SAME P_I positive-energy Hilbert space; S=X^dag X is its FULL Hermitian Gram including imaginary offdiagonal entries. Restrict to its actual positive support and put W=X S^(-1/2), R=P_I-WW^dag, K=(L/q)^2 on the band.
exact_two_polarization_convention.complete_matrix: M=W^dag K W=q^(-2)S^(-1/2)X^dag[64q J+(i q/2)L D]S^(-1/2). This COMPLETE expression is Hermitian by the exact native source identity. Its current and seam summands need not individually be Hermitian; never delete their imaginary cross or replace the expression by entrywise Re.
exact_two_polarization_convention.scalar_Re_meaning: The frozen proof's A_q=64q Re(b^dag j)/s is ONLY the scalar quadratic-form coefficient. If expanded to two-polarization quadratic forms, Re means the Hermitian part (X^dag J+J^dag X)/2, NOT entrywise real part. The same Hermitian-part convention applies to the source-parallel signed seam; their SUM must equal the full M above. A Hermitian matrix can and generally does retain imaginary offdiagonal entries.
exact_two_polarization_convention.irreducible_force: B=R[64q J+(i q/2)L D]S^(-1/2)/q^2. Full normalized memory is B^dag(z-R K R)^(-1)B, preserving every imaginary polarization cross. Source R projection is not wholeP0 and not a substitute for the signed source-parallel matrix.
